svg.title: The removed back channel beside return and retry
svg.desc: Two panels of equal size. The left one is outlined in a dashed alert colour and tagged REMOVED, Until 2025-11-25: a client calls tools/call, then the server sends an elicitation/create request backwards down the connection, drawn in the alert colour and labelled a request, going backwards. A note over the server reads the call is still open, the server holds state in memory, blocking. The client answers with an elicitation result and only then does the tool result come back. Its footer reads one connection, one machine, start to finish. The right panel is tagged 2026-07-28, Current: the client calls tools/call with id 1, the server answers input_required, labelled a result, going the normal way, and a note over the server reads the call is finished, the server holds nothing and can be restarted. The client then sends a second tools/call with id 2 and receives a complete result. Its footer reads two independent calls, they need not reach the same machine. A closing line states that servers must not initiate JSON-RPC requests in this revision and that the only arrow leaving a server is a result.
svg.text: The question travels in a result now, not in a request
Only the right-hand column exists in 2026-07-28. The left is drawn so you recognize it in old code.
One connection, one machine, start to finish.
a result, going the normal way
Two independent calls. They need not reach the same machine.
Servers must not initiate JSON-RPC requests in this revision. The only arrow leaving a server is a result.
